changelog:
• Bulletproof Camera Live Streaming: Single-socket strict enforcement, 4s frame timeout watchdog, and exponential backoff retry (1s, 2s, 4s, 5s)
• Wi-Fi Process Binding: App network automatically bound to camera Wi-Fi to eliminate mobile data interference on Android 10+
• Cyberpunk Reconnecting HUD: Smooth reconnecting status display without premature signal dropouts
• Dynamic Camera IP Configuration: Edit and switch camera endpoints with instant presets (192.168.1.102, 192.168.4.1, esp32cam.local)
• Leak-Free Lifecycle: Safe socket teardown and background thread shutdown on pause/exit
